description: This Java source file defines the ChunkFetchRequestHandler class, a Netty channel handler responsible for processing ChunkFetchRequest messages in Apache Spark's network module. It manages chunk transfer requests, handles exceptions, and controls response throttling based on sync mode.

classes.name: ChunkFetchRequestHandler
classes.description: A Netty channel handler for processing chunk fetch requests in Spark's network layer, managing chunk transfer flow, exception handling, and response throttling.

methods.name: ChunkFetchRequestHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with client, stream manager, max chunks, and sync mode settings.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Handles exceptions during channel processing by logging and closing the connection.

methods.name: processFetchRequest
methods.description: Main logic for handling chunk fetch requests, including authorization, chunk retrieval, and response sending.

methods.name: respond
methods.description: Sends response to the client, optionally waiting for completion if sync mode is enabled, and handles success or failure logging.
